purpose: Source reconnaissance only. This file contains no measurements and grants no permission to modify code.

rules: PASS requires no unresolved ambiguity and no unknown candidate.
BLOCKED is mandatory when any source line has multiple canonical candidate semantics.
FAIL is reserved for a scan that could not produce a valid result.

operators: Canonical operator semantic IDs from configs/semantic_ids.json.

fields.event_id: Positive integer in 1..4095 written by the recorder; it must equal semantic_event_ids[semantic_id]. Zero is the empty-record sentinel and is never a semantic event.
fields.event_id_const: Recorded C/C++ identifier EV_<SEMANTIC_ID>, for example EV_MMA.
fields.semantic_id: Canonical ID from configs/semantic_ids.json; unknown is forbidden in a deliverable event.
fields.source_line: Integer line number in the exact source SHA recorded in files[].
fields.source_sha256: SHA256 of the source file that was read.
fields.symbol: Function or device helper containing the insertion point.
fields.boundary: begin | completion | end | mark, with source-level evidence.

rules: A task or phase interval has exactly one begin and one end event.
Every event has a stable canonical event_id; IDs are never reused for different semantics.
Display labels come from semantic_id; no free-form label is accepted at capture time.
An explicit semantic selection may resolve a multi-candidate scan line only when the selected ID is one of that line's candidates.
A semantic ID not present in semantic_event_ids is unknown and cannot receive a device event ID.

ambiguities.rule: Each ambiguity also emits an unknown record with reason=ambiguous_semantic_candidates and forces status=BLOCKED. Never choose a winner silently.

unknown: List of unresolved language, target, operator, event or check decisions. Any entry blocks weaveprof/pipeline/instrument; ambiguity uses reason=ambiguous_semantic_candidates.
delivery_evidence: Always false for a source scan.
